rate_dataset.limitations: CSO averages are not matched supplier offers, delivered prices, employer-loaded wages or installed rates.

component_completion.dimensions_and_locations: No unverified physical dimensions or installation coordinates are invented. Material-equivalent volume is reported only where a declared density exists; generic reserves retain unknown material and dimensions.
component_completion.process_hours_scope: Process hours are estimated factory labour-hours, not elapsed production schedule; crew size, parallel workstations, tooling capacity, precedence and procurement lead times remain outside this component-level decomposition.

production_shift_basis.basis: The vehicle-package factory estimates use the two-shift production case. Civil work uses two shifts. City operating-cost cases retain two, two and three shifts/day.

component_completion.whole_system_cost_integration: Not added to the 112-bundle city model. These selected-candidate component estimates are a decomposition/replacement view; integrating them requires suppressing the corresponding aggregate account cost lines and closing cross-account overlap first.

geometry_reconciled_accounts.note: Accounting subtotal matches represented geometry. This does not verify installation or exclude unmodelled joints, fasteners, or interfaces.

interpretation: This is a provisional sensitivity of the existing selected-candidate mass account. The low/base/high factors are declared scenarios, not probability bounds. Positive residuals are replaced within each scenario; they are not added twice. Equipment, joint, fastener, cooling, wiring, and installation identities/locations remain open where the source worksheet has no physical component evidence.
